resources.string: Opens an app of your choice automatically after the device has started.

Most TV sticks do not shut down when switched off – they only go to standby. When switched on again they do not restart, so the autostart after a restart would not run. With this option AutoStartTV also opens the app when the device wakes from standby. A small background service waits for this.

Since Android 10, apps running in the background may not open other apps. After switching on, AutoStartTV runs in the background – only with this permission can it open the chosen app. AutoStartTV does not display anything over other apps itself.\n\nAfter installing, open AutoStartTV once: Android only runs the autostart of apps that have been opened before.

This device has no settings screen for \"Display over other apps\". Run on a computer:\n\nadb shell appops set de.autostarttv SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow
When switched on, many TV sticks first open their own start page or app (e.g. waipu.tv). If AutoStartTV opens the chosen app too early, it is covered by it again. 5–10 seconds are recommended.
